childNodes.textContent: Every month on the same weekday
Save changes every repeat. To change only this date, use Change this one only; to take it out, Delete this one.
Anyone who sees a shared to-do can tick it off.
Only you and the lab's admins can change a shared event.
No instruments yet. Add one under Equipment → Manage.

attributes.title: Save what the dialog says for this date only; the other repeats stay as they are
A new booking like this one: change the day or time, then Save

childNodes.textContent: Every step lands on the calendar, counted from day 0. Move day 0 and they all move.
A protocol is a list of steps counted in days from day 0. Runs already under way keep the steps they started with.
Shared instruments people book time on. Two bookings of one instrument can't overlap.
A private link that Apple, Google or Outlook Calendar subscribes to. It updates by itself, about every hour.
Your events, to-dos, animals, vials, protocols, bookings, and time away you cover
Everything on this page except calendars you connected
Settings → Calendar → Calendar Accounts → Add Account → Other → Add Subscribed Calendar, then paste.
Other calendars → + → From URL. Google fetches it from the internet, so it works only when the server is open to the internet.
Anyone with the link can read this calendar. If it ends up somewhere it shouldn't, make a new one and the old link stops working.
Show events from Google Calendar or any iCal feed alongside your own. They are read-only here.
Paste a feed URL: Apple, Outlook, a university calendar, or Google's secret iCal address.
